targets.name: SceneResource_ClearC000AndWritePhaseRows
targets.behavior: Programs the scene VDP mode, clears the initial C000 block, and writes sixteen phase-selected row pairs using SCENE_VDP_TRANSITION_PLANE_OFFSET_TABLE and FRAME_PHASE_COUNTER.
targets.reachability: No direct static selector is currently recovered.

targets.name: SceneResource_LoadC000AndRunFrameService
targets.behavior: Loads a caller-selected resource to C000, performs one actor/render frame, uploads the caller-selected and fixed palette bands, processes the caller-selected scene command stream, waits 250 frames, and clears active actors and the fixed VDP header.
targets.reachability: No direct static selector is currently recovered.

targets.name: SceneResource_RunSharedC000Presentation
targets.behavior: Programs the scene VDP mode, decompresses 0x0012D0FA to C000, uploads palette source 0x00129812, emits the fixed C000 presentation fill through 0x00FFF0A0, and performs the shared wait/fade/reset completion.
targets.reachability: No direct static selector is currently recovered.
